text: Which vehicles have a previous owner?
Which people own both a vehicle and an animal?
queries:
MATCH p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Person)] >[has_vehicle] v[Vehicle]
MATCH p >[has_animal] a[SUB_CLASS_OF(Animal)]
RETURN p

MATCH a[SUB_CLASS_OF(Animal)] >[has_owner] p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Person)] >[has_vehicle] v[Vehicle]
RETURN p

MATCH v[Vehicle] >[vehicle_owned_by] p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Person)] >[has_animal] a[SUB_CLASS_OF(Animal)]
RETURN p

text: Which companies are owned by people who own vehicles?
queries:
MATCH v[Vehicle] >[vehicle_owned_by] o[CompanyOwner] >[owns_company] c[Company]
RETURN c

text: Which employees live in the country where their company is located?
queries:
MATCH e[Employee] >[works_for] cp[Company] >[has_legal_office_in] a1[Address] >[located_in] country[Country]
MATCH e >[resident_in] a2[Address] >[located_in] country
RETURN e

text: Which people are friends with company owners?
Which employees work for companies owned by one of their friends?
queries:
MATCH e[Employee] >[works_for] c[Company] >[company_owner] o[CompanyOwner] >[friend_of] e
RETURN e

MATCH e[Employee] >[works_for] c[Company] >[company_owner] o[CompanyOwner]
MATCH e >[friend_of] o
RETURN e

text: Which people own vehicles whose previous owner is one of their friends?
queries:
MATCH p1[SUB_CLASS_OF(Person)] >[has_vehicle] v[Vehicle] >[previous_owner] p2[SUB_CLASS_OF(Person)] >[friend_of] p1
RETURN p1

text: Which employees have partners working for the same company?
queries:
MATCH e1[Employee] >[works_for] c[Company]
MATCH e1 >[has_relation_with] e2[Employee] >[works_for] c
RETURN e1

text: Which company owners live in a different country from their company's legal office?
queries:
MATCH o[CompanyOwner] >[owns_company] c[Company] >[has_legal_office_in] a1[Address] >[located_in] c1[Country]
MATCH o >[resident_in] a2[Address] >[located_in] c2[Country]
REQUIRE c1 DIFFERENT_FROM c2 
RETURN o

text: Which people own companies whose legal office is located in the country where one of their friends resides?
queries:
MATCH o[CompanyOwner] >[owns_company] c[Company] >[has_legal_office_in] a1[Address] >[located_in] c1[Country]
MATCH p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Person)] >[resident_in] a2[Address] >[located_in] c2[Country]
MATCH p >[friend_of] o
REQUIRE c1 SAME_AS c2
RETURN o

MATCH o[CompanyOwner] >[owns_company] c[Company] >[has_legal_office_in] a1[Address] >[located_in] c1[Country]
MATCH p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Person)] >[resident_in] a2[Address] >[located_in] c1
MATCH p >[friend_of] o
RETURN o

MATCH o[CompanyOwner] >[owns_company] c[Company] >[has_legal_office_in] a1[Address] >[located_in] c1[Country]
MATCH o >[friend_of] p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Person)] >[resident_in] a2[Address] >[located_in] c1
RETURN o

text: Which people own vehicles previously owned by someone working for the same company?
queries:
MATCH v[Vehicle] >[owned_by] e1[Employee] >[works_for] c[Company]
MATCH e2[Employee] >[works_for] c
MATCH v >[previous_owner] e2
RETURN e1

text: Which employee are friends of employees of a partner company?
queries:
MATCH e1[Employee] >[works_for] c1[Company]
MATCH e1 >[friend_of] e2[Employee] >[works_for] c2[Company]
MATCH c1 >[partner_of] c2
REQUIRE c1 DIFFERENT_FROM c2
RETURN e1, e2

text: Which animal is owned by someone who has more than 20000€ in bank?
queries:
MATCH a[SUB_CLASS_OF(Animal)] >[has_owner] p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Person)] >[bank_account] b[BankAccount]{money>20000}
RETURN a

text: Which animal owner owns animals of different types?
queries:
MATCH p[SUB_CLASS_OF(Person)] >[has_animal] a1[SUB_CLASS_OF(Animal)]
MATCH p >[has_animal] a2[SUB_CLASS_OF(Animal)]
REQUIRE a1 DISJOINT_CLASS_FROM a2
RETURN p
